9798173634580.sourceDescription: 【CHRISTMAS BOXWOOD TOPIARY BALLS - 2 PACK】 These artificial boxwood topiary trees feature dense white and green foliage with a beautiful snow-dusted look. The full, rounded shape adds elegant winter charm to front doors, porches and outdoor Christmas decorations. 【UV RESISTANT & WEATHER-READY】 Made from durable UV-resistant materials, these faux evergreen shrubs are designed for outdoor display. Enjoy decorative greenery through changing British weather without watering, pruning or regular maintenance. 【62CM TALL WITH GROUND SPIKES】 Each artificial topiary tree measures approximately 62cm tall, including an 18cm ground spike, with a 40cm wide ball. Simply insert into soil, garden beds or decorative planters and adjust the foliage for a fuller appearance. 【2 PACK FOR CHRISTMAS FRONT DOOR DECOR】 Create a balanced festive entrance with two matching white and green topiary balls. Place them in outdoor urns, beside porch steps or along garden pathways for a welcoming Christmas display. 【VERSATILE & REUSABLE SEASONAL DECOR】 These artificial boxwood balls complement Christmas wreaths, fairy lights and festive planters. Their classic evergreen-style design also suits patios, balconies and garden entrances throughout the year.

Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and PVC construction give them a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Water Resistant
The water resistant construction is useful where occasional moisture is part of the intended use. Allow damp surfaces to dry after use and follow the stated limits for exposure.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

String lights can be threaded through the hollows for those who take their tree seriously, and the sparkle survives seasons of assembling and disassembling.

A tree full of identical baubles looks tidy and says nothing. Throwing letter initials into the mix gives the whole thing a bit of personality without descending into clutter, and it's a decoration people actually look at rather than glance past.

These are flat-cut acrylic, roughly eight centimetres, with UV-printed colour that stays crisp rather than bleeding. Every letter has a little snowman in a red hat next to it, so the set has a consistent feel even though each initial is different.

The hanging string comes already threaded through the drilled holes, which saves the usual fiddling about. They're light on the branches and because they're acrylic rather than glass there's a real argument for letting children hang them themselves.

Material: Acrylic with UV printing
Adds personality without cluttering the tree
Flat-cut acrylic around 8 cm, crisp printed colour
Consistent snowman design ties the whole set together
String pre-threaded, no fiddling with tiny hooks
Light and unbreakable, safe for children to hang
Guarantee - 1 month

5056797099180.sourceDescription:
Create a luxurious festive display with this light up Christmas tree from MySmartBuy. The modern tiered tree outline is densely wrapped in 720 warm white micro LEDs, creating a rich, sparkling glow that makes a beautiful focal point in a window, on a sideboard or on a shelf. The stylish champagne gold metal frame stands on slim legs above a flat base, so it sits neatly and securely on windowsills, tabletops and mantelpieces. At 45cm tall, it is a versatile size that makes an impact without taking over the room, and looks just as elegant unlit during the day. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening and greets passers-by with a warm festive glow from your window. Pair it with the matching champagne gold snowflake for a coordinated look, or group it with candles and greenery for an elegant Christmas display. At a glance: 45cm tall | 720 warm white micro LEDs | champagne gold metal frame on a flat base | 5m lead cable | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | indoor use.
SPARKLING TIERED TREE – A modern Christmas tree outline densely wrapped in 720 warm white micro LEDs for a rich festive glow.
CHAMPAGNE GOLD FRAME – A stylish metal frame on slim legs and a flat base, looking elegant lit or unlit.
45CM TALL – A versatile size for windowsills, tabletops, sideboards, shelves and mantelpieces.
5M LEAD CABLE – Plenty of reach from your socket, so you can place it exactly where it looks best.
AUTOMATIC TIMER – Built-in 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer, so your window glows at the same time every evening.

5058194836580.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and PVC construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: PVC. Colour: Red. Product measurements: length 200 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive red PVC wreath with a sparkling glitter finish for eye-catching Christmas decor.
Generous 200 cm length creates a bold focal point for doors and walls.
Durable PVC construction ensures long-lasting seasonal decoration year after year.
Versatile design allows easy placement on doors, mantels or as part of a coordinated display.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Double Sided Design
The two sided design gives you a choice of usable surfaces or presentation. Turn the item to the side that suits the intended arrangement.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion

Give the detail room to show

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: White. Product measurements: length 30 cm, width 25 cm, height 2 cm. Quantity: 1 set.
Double-sided design allows you to choose between two usable surfaces or presentation styles for your festive display.
Compact plastic construction in white provides a defined appearance suitable for coordinating with existing room accents.
Versatile decoration can be moved and adjusted within its setting to refresh the look of your Christmas arrangement.
Single set includes one festive ornament designed to create a focal point when displayed with space around it.

0609137988580.variantName: 48 Inch LED Snowflake Rotating Prismatic Star Christmas Light Outdoor
0609137988580.sourceDescription:
Transform your holiday home display into a breathtaking winter scene with the 48-Inch (122cm) LED Snowflake with Rotating Prismatic Star Light. Specifically engineered as a grand-scale seasonal focal point, this striking light-up display features a majestic, multi-tiered snowflake structure centered by a magical, spinning star centerpiece that completely elevates your property’s festive curb presence.
Equipped with 180 high-brilliance, energy-efficient LED lights, the snowflake emits a crisp, icy glow while remaining completely cold to the touch. To add a dynamic, magical shimmer to your display, 15 integrated micro-bulbs subtly twinkle while the central prismatic star rotates smoothly. Built around a commercial-grade, rust-resistant powder-coated metal frame, it includes heavy-duty metal ground stakes for solid lawn stabilization. Outfitted with an extra-long 10-meter lead wire and a certified UK outdoor plug adapter, it offers absolute placement freedom across front lawns, patios, entryways, or indoor living rooms.
Dynamic Rotating Prismatic Center: Features a mesmerizing central star that continuously rotates inside the snowflake, creating a shimmering, multi-dimensional light show.
180 Twinkling Cold-Touch LEDs: Pre-strung with 180 brilliant, energy-saving LED bulbs—including 15 specialized twinkling nodes—that run completely cool to the touch.

Inflatable Santa
It adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Key details include father Christmas motif.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details

Generous dimensions of 140 x 100 x 240 cm create a substantial focal point for seasonal arrangements.
Constructed from durable fabric material suitable for indoor Christmas decoration use.
Easy to position and move, allowing flexible styling within your coordinated holiday decor.

5056141000480.sourceDescription:
Create a warm festive centrepiece with this 7ft Stockholm Pine artificial Christmas tree. Designed with berries, frosted cones and a mix of realistic tip styles, it offers a full, natural-looking finish that suits medium to large rooms. The mixed PE and PVC leaf design helps give the tree a lifelike appearance while keeping seasonal decorating simple year after year. It is quick and easy to assemble, making Christmas preparation more convenient. A metal stand is included for added stability, and the tree is flame retardant for extra peace of mind. Supplied in a strong storage box, it can be packed away neatly after the season and brought out again whenever you want to recreate the same stylish festive look.
Decorated with berries, frosted cones and mixed tips for a fuller festive look with a natural-style finish.

Flame retardant construction adds reassurance when choosing seasonal décor for your home.
